Container.Name: open-parcels
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted parcel and order tracking. Signs in to carriers and shops, reads shipping mails, follows couriers live on a map, keeps a delivery calendar (also as an ICS feed) and publishes events for Home Assistant and other clients.
Set an admin password below, or on first start read the one-time setup code from the container log and enter it in the web UI to choose one. Without a reader password anyone on your network can read (not change) your parcels.
The image runs as uid 1000. The data folder must be writable for that user (chown 1000:1000), or set Extra Parameters to --user 99:100 and make the folder writable for nobody:users.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI and the API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encryption key and image cache. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Optional: 32 random bytes as base64 (openssl rand -base64 32). When empty, a key file is created in the data folder on first start. Never change it afterwards: stored carrier sign-ins would become unreadable.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional: the address you open the web UI at (for example https://parcels.example.com). Used for links in the calendar feed.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password to change anything (at least 10 characters). Empty: the first start asks for the setup code from the log. Can also be changed in Settings.

Config.Name: Reader password
Config.Description: Password to read. Empty: anyone who can reach the server can read (not change) everything.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to true when the web UI is served over HTTPS (for example behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace.
